data.text:
'MAXIMUM TOLERANCE WILL BE STRICTLY OBSERVED' 

Titiyakin ng Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ang kaligtasan at kaayusan sa Trillion Peso March protest sa Linggo, Nov. 30, kasama ang Philippine National Police. 

Ayon sa ahensya, mahigpit na ipatutupad ang maximum tolerance at sinuspinde ang permit to carry firearms outside of residence sa Metro Manila mula Nov. 29 hanggang Dec. 1.

“Our commitment would always be simple and firm: protect every citizen, maintain public order, and ensure that this mass action proceeds safely,” saad ng DILG.
